screenLevelIssues.explanation: Figma design specifies a 4-digit OTP input (and corresponding text '4-digit code'), but the Simulator implementation shows a 6-digit input with '6-digit code' text. This also forces the input boxes to be smaller than the designed 64px.
The vertical spacing (gap) between the subtitle, OTP input, and 'Proceed' button in the bottom sheet is 24px in Figma, but appears significantly larger in the Simulator.
The background screen in Figma shows the 'Filled' state with data ('98765 43210'), whereas the Simulator shows the 'Empty/Placeholder' state ('Enter Number').
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode: value={'98765 43210'} // Ensure state is pre-filled for this screen variant
